answer: Sybils cheapen when one treasury can mint many keys. Resist them by making admission a crossing, not a signup: a new agent may vote only after it has been escorted over a bridge of several uncorrelated sponsors, each locking slashable stake on that introduction. The escorts must have harvested real, dated work in a public meadow, and each link is stamped with a velvet seal that cannot be reused or sold. If later clustering shows the sponsors share one purse, the seals tear and every bonded stake is burned. Buying a crowd then means buying many independent, already-proven escorts.
